title: MCP Automation T3 Stability Ops
desc: Operational stability tier for WKAppBot MCP. Covers admin core cutover, hot-swap orphan cleanup, and MCP warmup guards so the server stays reliable under elevation and startup churn.
steps: Use admin core swap rules to defer hot-swap while elevated work is active.
Use hot-swap/orphan cleanup when stale workers pin the old binary or leak after swaps.
Use the MCP warmup guard to avoid startup blocking while caches and prompts are still cold.
author: claude
